hong-kong-belt-and-road-scholarship-rese.about:
The HKSAR Government's Belt and Road Scholarship (Research Postgraduate) is offered to outstanding first-year students from Belt and Road countries who enrol in full-time research postgraduate programmes (MPhil/PhD) at UGC-funded universities such as CUHK, HKU, HKUST, PolyU and CityU. It covers full tuition fees for the normative study period and is renewed annually subject to satisfactory performance.

Students are nominated through their university after admission, so the key step is to apply for an MPhil/PhD by the university's deadline. Combined with a university studentship (e.g. HK$229,200 a year at CUHK), it effectively makes research study fully funded.
highlights: Full tuition for the whole MPhil/PhD
Georgia is on the Belt and Road country list
hong-kong-belt-and-road-scholarship-rese.eligibility: Nationals of Belt and Road countries (list on the Belt and Road Portal; includes Georgia; check Qatar) admitted as first-year full-time research postgraduates at a UGC-funded Hong Kong university.
how_to_apply: Check that your country is on the Belt and Road list
Apply for a full-time MPhil/PhD at a UGC-funded university by its deadline
Universities nominate eligible admitted students
Awards confirmed with or after admission
hong-kong-belt-and-road-scholarship-rese.costs: Full tuition fees for the normative study period.

icu-peace-bell-scholarship-2027.about:
International Christian University in Tokyo is Japan's leading English-and-Japanese bilingual liberal arts university. Applicants through English Language Based Admissions (ELBA) can apply for pre-enrolment scholarships: the ICU Peace Bell Scholarship (about 14 recipients; matriculation, tuition and facilities fees and on-campus dormitory fees for four years), the University of Tomorrow Scholarship (one student from a UN Least Developed Country; the same plus living expenses) and the ICU Torch Relay High Endeavor Scholarship (first-term tuition-level awards for four years).

No Japanese is needed for ELBA entry. ELBA online applications for April 2027 entry opened on 1 Oct 2026, with September 2027 entry rounds later; scholarship applications (essay and recommendation) are submitted with the admission application.
highlights: Full tuition + dormitory for 4 years (Peace Bell)
Living costs too for LDC students
icu-peace-bell-scholarship-2027.eligibility: International applicants through ELBA (April or September 2027 entry). University of Tomorrow limited to nationals of UN Least Developed Countries.
how_to_apply: Read the ICU Undergraduate Admissions Guide for 2027 (April/September entry)
Apply online via ELBA with essays and recommendation
Submit the scholarship application materials with your admission application
Scholars are selected before enrolment
icu-peace-bell-scholarship-2027.costs: Peace Bell: matriculation, tuition, facilities and dorm fees for 4 years (about JPY 2 million/year); UoT adds living expenses.

iec-academic-programmes-italy-georgia-20.about:
Based on a memorandum between IEC and the Conference of Italian University Rectors (CRUI), this partner programme aims to give Georgian students access to Italian master's and doctoral programmes and bring the skills back to Georgia's economy.

Master's funding is limited to priority fields announced each year (in 2025-26 these included areas linked to Georgia's labour-market needs); PhD funding is open to any field. Applicants must already be admitted to, or applying to, an eligible Italian programme. Art applicants submit a portfolio.

Italian public universities have low tuition, so the IEC grant goes a long way towards covering a full degree.
highlights: Funds Italian master's (priority fields) and PhD (any field)
Backed by CRUI, the Italian rectors' conference
Can be combined with Italy's low public-university fees
iec-academic-programmes-italy-georgia-20.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia (or holders of Georgian status-neutral documents) admitted to an eligible Italian master's or PhD programme; graduates must commit to the programme's return/work conditions in Georgia.
how_to_apply: Pick an Italian master's in a priority field (list published with the call) or any PhD.
Register on app.iec.gov.ge when the call opens (May).
Upload CV, motivation letter, diploma, admission/application proof and portfolio (art fields).
Pass the IEC technical check and evaluation; sign the grant contract if selected.
iec-academic-programmes-italy-georgia-20.costs: IEC funds tuition and/or living costs up to the ceilings in the call (paid in GEL/EUR); exact amounts are set each year.

iec-france-excellence-masters-georgia-20.about:
France Excellence for Georgia is a partner programme between IEC and the French Institute of Georgia (French Embassy), administered with Campus France. It is co-funded by Georgia and by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs and Ministry of Higher Education.

Winners hold both an IEC grant and French government scholar status: IEC pays a €560 monthly study grant and a €300 monthly stipend, and the French side provides benefits such as visa facilitation, social security and exemption from tuition at public institutions. Applicants handle admission to French universities themselves; priority fields are listed in each call, with some interdisciplinary fields also considered.
highlights: €860 per month in total (study grant + stipend)
French government scholar status and benefits
iec-france-excellence-masters-georgia-20.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia aged 30 or under, holding (or completing) a bachelor's degree, applying to master's programmes at French higher education institutions in the call's priority fields.
how_to_apply: Choose a French master's in a priority field and apply for admission (Campus France procedure).
Register on app.iec.gov.ge between mid-December and 31 January and upload CV, motivation, diplomas and language certificates.
Complete the parallel Campus France/French Institute steps described in the call.
Attend interviews; winners sign the IEC contract.
iec-france-excellence-masters-georgia-20.costs: IEC: €560/month study grant + €300/month stipend. French side: scholar status benefits (tuition exemption at public institutions, visa and social security support).

iec-stipendium-hungaricum-cofunding-geor.about:
Stipendium Hungaricum covers tuition and a modest stipend in Hungary. Because living costs exceed the Hungarian stipend, Georgia's International Education Center runs a partner programme that adds state funding for high-achieving Georgian SH holders at bachelor's and master's level.

In 2025-26 the top-up was €1,250 per semester (paid in GEL equivalent). Recipients commit to return to Georgia within one month of graduating and to work there, though graduates may continue to further study abroad in the same field.
highlights: €1,250 extra per semester on top of Stipendium Hungaricum
For Georgian SH winners with high grades
iec-stipendium-hungaricum-cofunding-geor.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia holding a Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship with high academic performance (criteria in the call); return-and-work obligation applies.
how_to_apply: Win a Stipendium Hungaricum place (separate application via the Tempus Public Foundation).
When the IEC co-funding call opens (July), apply on app.iec.gov.ge with your SH award letter and transcripts.
Applications received by mid-August and mid-September are reviewed in batches.
Sign the IEC contract if approved.
iec-stipendium-hungaricum-cofunding-geor.costs: €1,250 per semester (GEL equivalent), in addition to the Hungarian scholarship.

ieseg-bachelor-scholarships-tuition-waiv.about:
IÉSEG School of Management (Lille and Paris-La Défense) offers an English-taught Bachelor in International Business and a Bachelor in Management & Tech Design. It awards large numbers of scholarships as tuition waivers of up to €5,000 to students who meet the criteria; no separate application is needed, as decisions are made by the admission commission and released with the admission decision.

Students with financial difficulties can also apply to IÉSEG's financial support commissions for a need-based tuition waiver (with guarantors' income documents) or a 0% 'loan of honour' repaid after graduation. International students of any nationality are eligible.
ieseg-bachelor-scholarships-tuition-waiv.eligibility: Applicants to IÉSEG bachelor's programmes (any nationality) meeting merit criteria; need-based support requires a financial file.
how_to_apply: Apply to an IÉSEG bachelor's programme in one of the 2027 admission rounds.
Merit waivers are announced with your admission decision.
For need-based help, send a letter and guarantors' income/tax documents to a financial support commission.
ieseg-bachelor-scholarships-tuition-waiv.costs: Tuition waivers up to €5,000; need-based waivers and interest-free honour loans also available.

isu-bocconi-scholarship-first-year-bache.about:
The ISU Bocconi Scholarship is Bocconi's right-to-study award (the Lombardy 'diritto allo studio' system) for students enrolled in Bachelor of Science and Law programmes, as well as MSc and PhD. It combines a grant with related services and supplements (such as accommodation) and is renewable each year if you meet merit (credit) requirements.

International students are eligible when they meet the economic, enrolment and merit requirements. First-year bachelor's candidates must first submit the single 'Bocconi4Access to Education' application and then the ISU application in the window for their admission session: 12–30 November 2026 for international candidates in the Early Session, or 15 March – 5 April 2027 for the Winter Session.
isu-bocconi-scholarship-first-year-bache.eligibility: Students admitted to the first year of a Bocconi Bachelor of Science or Law programme in 2027-28 who meet economic (family income/assets) requirements; any nationality, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to a Bocconi bachelor's (Early or Winter Session).
Submit the 'Bocconi4Access to Education 2027-28' application.
Submit the ISU Bocconi Scholarship application in your session's window (Early: 12–30 Nov 2026; Winter: 15 Mar – 5 Apr 2027).
Provide the required family income and asset documents.
Earn the required credits to keep the award in later years.
isu-bocconi-scholarship-first-year-bache.costs: Annual grant amount depends on family economic situation and whether you live away from home; includes services and supplements such as accommodation.

john-cabot-global-explorer-full-scholars.about:
John Cabot University (JCU) is an English-language, US-accredited liberal arts university in Rome's Trastevere district. It awards about $8 million a year, and 85% of students receive a JCU scholarship or grant.

The Global Explorer Scholarship is its most competitive award: full tuition for up to three students in each incoming Fall class, recognising outstanding academic achievement, leadership potential and commitment to making a positive impact. You apply through JCU's single Merit-Based Scholarship Application; the committee awards each applicant the highest-value merit scholarship they qualify for. Housing and personal costs are not covered. Open to all nationalities.
highlights: Full tuition, up to 3 per year
One application for all merit awards
john-cabot-global-explorer-full-scholars.eligibility: Incoming first-year Fall students of any nationality with outstanding academics, leadership and community impact.
how_to_apply: Apply for undergraduate admission to JCU for Fall 2027.
Complete the Merit-Based Scholarship Application (online form).
Include strong essays, recommendations and evidence of leadership.
You are notified of any award with your acceptance.
john-cabot-global-explorer-full-scholars.costs: Full tuition (Fall and Spring semesters). Does not cover housing, travel, books or personal costs.

john-cabot-presidential-scholarship-2027.about:
The Presidential Scholarship is a prestigious partial-tuition award that John Cabot University gives on acceptance for outstanding academic achievement. Recipients receive up to $9,500 (€7,000) per academic year, renewable each year if they keep a cumulative GPA of 2.67 and make academic progress.

It is one of several merit awards (others target specific regions, e.g. the Expansion Scholarship for Latin America and Africa) assessed through one Merit-Based Scholarship Application, and can be combined with need-based aid. Open to all nationalities.
john-cabot-presidential-scholarship-2027.eligibility: Incoming first-year undergraduates with outstanding academic records; any nationality.
how_to_apply: Apply for undergraduate admission to JCU.
Submit the Merit-Based Scholarship Application.
Receive your award with your acceptance letter.
john-cabot-presidential-scholarship-2027.costs: Up to $9,500 (€7,000) per academic year toward tuition.

johns-hopkins-financial-aid-internationa.about:
Johns Hopkins University offers need-based financial aid to international first-year applicants. For admitted international citizens, Hopkins meets 100% of demonstrated need with no loans, meaning the aid package is made of grants and work-study.

Admission is need-aware for international students who apply for aid, so your request is considered in the admission decision. A limited number of merit scholarships are awarded automatically. If you do not apply for aid as a first-year, you cannot apply later.

Apply via Common App or Coalition by 2 Jan 2027 (RD/ED II) and submit the CSS Profile or the free JHU International Student Financial Aid Application by 15 Jan 2027. All international applicants also submit a Certification of Finances.
highlights: 100% of demonstrated need met without loans
Free JHU aid form available instead of the CSS Profile
johns-hopkins-financial-aid-internationa.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-year students. International transfer students are not eligible for aid. Aid must be requested at the time of application.
how_to_apply: Apply by 2 Jan 2027 (RD) and indicate that you need financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile or JHU International Student Financial Aid Application by 15 Jan 2027
Submit the Certification of Finances from your applicant portal
Receive aid award with admission decision
johns-hopkins-financial-aid-internationa.costs: Grant aid covering demonstrated need (tuition, housing, meals, fees, books, travel) with no loans for international citizens.

jonkoping-university-scholarship-bachelo.about:
Jönköping University (JU), known for its International Business School and engineering, offers merit-based scholarships worth 10%, 20% or 30% of the tuition fee for the bachelor's or master's programme a student is admitted to.

Applicants must be citizens of a country required to pay tuition in Sweden (all non-EU/EEA countries, including Georgia and Qatar), have applied to an on-site JU programme and submit a complete scholarship application. You can apply before receiving your programme offer. It cannot be combined with JU's partner-organisation scholarships (FIDERH, FUNED, COLFUTURO).
highlights: 10–30% of tuition for the whole programme
jonkoping-university-scholarship-bachelo.eligibility: Citizens of countries required to pay tuition in Sweden who have applied to an on-site JU bachelor's or master's programme starting Autumn 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for a JU bachelor's programme via University Admissions in Sweden (universityadmissions.se), round closing mid-January.
Submit the JU scholarship application between 16 Oct 2026 and 2 May 2027.
Receive the decision after admission results.

kaist-international-graduate-scholarship.about:
KAIST, South Korea's leading science and technology university, funds almost all of its international graduate students. Applicants who choose 'KAIST Scholarship' as their financial resource are considered automatically: the scholarship covers full tuition and national health insurance and pays a monthly stipend linked to research involvement (amounts vary by college).

The most competitive master's or integrated master's-PhD applicants are recommended for the KAIST Global Presidential Scholarship (KGPS): full tuition plus KRW 1,000,000 a month for four semesters; PhD applicants can receive the KAIST Prestige Scholarship (KPS). Several partner-funded schemes (e.g. Samsung-linked tracks) add higher stipends for specific countries or fields.

The Fall 2027 application window runs 7 January–5 February 2027; GKS University Track applicants use a separate early-February deadline.
highlights: Full tuition + stipend for 94% of international grads
kaist-international-graduate-scholarship.eligibility: International applicants (non-Korean citizens, all nationalities incl. Georgia and Qatar) to KAIST master's, integrated or PhD programmes (except GDI-GTIP).
how_to_apply: Pick a KAIST department and check its requirements
Apply online 7 January–5 February 2027 for Fall entry
Select 'KAIST Scholarship' as your financial resource
Upload transcripts, study plan, recommendations and English scores; interview if requested
kaist-international-graduate-scholarship.costs: Full tuition, national health insurance, monthly stipend (KGPS: KRW 1,000,000/month for 4 semesters).

kazakhstan-government-scholarship-georgi.about:
Based on the February 2025 agreement between Georgia's Ministry of Education, Science and Youth and Kazakhstan's Ministry of Science and Higher Education, this programme lets Georgian citizens study a complete degree in Kazakhstan with tuition and living costs paid. IEC runs the national competition and nominates candidates.

In the 2025-26 round there were 2 bachelor's places, 2 master's places and 1 PhD place, at universities listed in an annex to the call. Teaching is in Kazakh, Russian or English depending on the programme.

With very few places and a small applicant pool, a well-prepared application has a realistic chance.
highlights: Tuition and living costs funded by Kazakhstan
Small Georgia-only competition run by IEC
kazakhstan-government-scholarship-georgi.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia (or holders of Georgian status-neutral documents) with the previous level of education completed (school certificate for bachelor's, bachelor's for master's, master's for PhD).
how_to_apply: Look for the call on iec.gov.ge in spring 2027.
Fill in the application form for Kazakh universities (annex to the call) and choose from the listed universities.
Prepare passport copy, notarised English translations of diploma/transcript, motivation and recommendation letters (Kazakh or English), medical/HIV certificate and police clearance.
E-mail the full package to info-iec@iec.gov.ge before the deadline; fix any technical errors within the correction window.
Attend an IEC group meeting/interview if invited.
kazakhstan-government-scholarship-georgi.costs: Tuition plus a living allowance paid under the bilateral agreement; check the call for current amounts.

keele-undergraduate-global-scholarship-2.about:
Keele University in Staffordshire lists the Undergraduate Global Scholarship for 2026/27 and 2027/28 entry: a £3,000 tuition fee discount for international fee-paying students, awarded automatically on academic achievement. An Advanced Entry Scholarship (£3,000) and an International Baccalaureate Global Scholarship (£1,000) are also available.

Keele has one of the UK's largest single-site campuses and is strong in medicine-related sciences, law, and natural sciences. All nationalities qualify.
keele-undergraduate-global-scholarship-2.eligibility: International fee-paying undergraduate entrants for 2027/28 meeting the academic achievement criteria.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Meet the academic achievement criteria in your offer.
The discount is applied automatically.
keele-undergraduate-global-scholarship-2.costs: £3,000 tuition fee discount (plus £1,000 for eligible IB diploma holders).

korea-university-international-freshman-.about:
Korea University, one of Korea's top three 'SKY' universities, awards several scholarships to newly admitted international undergraduates through the admission evaluation, with no separate application: Anam Global Scholarship (100% tuition for 8 semesters), Global Leader Scholarship A (100% for 4 semesters) and B (50% for 4 semesters), KU Global Friends (100% for 4 semesters, for applicants from Africa, South America or other developing countries), KU STEM Scholarship (100% for 4 semesters for proven STEM achievement) and Bright Futures (KRW 1,000,000 per semester for national scholarship recipients).

Continuation requires a GPA of 3.0-3.5 and 12+ credits each semester. Apply in the Fall 2027 international admission round (typically early spring); English-track and Korean-track programmes are available.
highlights: Up to 100% tuition for all 8 semesters
Special award for Africa, South America and developing countries
korea-university-international-freshman-.eligibility: International freshmen (both parents and applicant non-Korean citizens, per KU admission rules) admitted through international admission.
how_to_apply: Check the Fall 2027 international admission guide on Korea University's admissions site
Apply online with transcripts, language scores and essays
Submit STEM certificates or national scholarship proof if relevant
Scholarship decided with admission
korea-university-international-freshman-.costs: 50%-100% tuition for 4-8 semesters, or fixed KRW stipends.

lake-forest-college-international-schola.about:
Lake Forest College is a liberal arts college 30 miles north of Chicago with a large international community. Admitted international students can receive a merit scholarship of up to US$37,000 a year, plus Fine Arts Scholarships in music, studio art and theatre (audition or portfolio, deadline 1 March). With need-based aid, scholarships and grants for 2026-27 entrants totalled up to US$48,000 a year, plus possible work-study.

For need-based aid submit the CSS Profile (code 1392): Lake Forest will not review your admission application until it arrives. Aid continues at the same level each year with consistent performance.
highlights: Merit up to US$37,000 a year
Up to US$48,000 total with need aid
lake-forest-college-international-schola.eligibility: International first-year applicants. Need-based aid requires the CSS Profile.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by 15 Feb 2027 (RD) or earlier rounds
Submit the CSS Profile (code 1392) for need-based aid
Optional: apply for Fine Arts Scholarships by 1 March
Merit is assessed automatically
lake-forest-college-international-schola.costs: Up to US$48,000/year in scholarships and grants against tuition of about US$55,000.

lancaster-masters-excellence-scholarship.about:
Lancaster University's Master's Excellence Scholarship rewards students who achieve a 2:1 or first-class undergraduate degree (or equivalent) with a 15% tuition fee reduction worth up to £4,635. It applies to taught master's programmes starting in 2027 and is the main merit award for international students from countries not covered by Lancaster's regional scholarships, including Georgia and Qatar.

You are considered automatically when you apply. Lancaster also offers a £2,000 early-acceptance scholarship to international students who accept their place before 7 April 2027.
highlights: Stack with £2,000 early-acceptance award (accept by 7 April 2027)
lancaster-masters-excellence-scholarship.eligibility: Applicants (any nationality, incl. Georgia and Qatar) with a 2:1 or first-class degree or equivalent, starting a taught master's at Lancaster in 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for a taught master's at Lancaster
Meet the 2:1/first-class grade condition
The reduction is applied automatically
Accept before 7 April 2027 to also receive the £2,000 Early Acceptance Scholarship

lancaster-postgraduate-international-ear.about:
Lancaster University rewards international postgraduate taught students who commit early: if you accept your offer for 2027 entry before 23:59 GMT on 7 April 2027, you receive a £2,000 Early Acceptance Scholarship. No separate application is required.

It is a small award but easy to obtain, and useful when combined with Lancaster's Master's Excellence (15%) or International Regional (£10,000) scholarships, subject to their terms.
highlights: Just accept your offer by 7 April 2027
lancaster-postgraduate-international-ear.eligibility: International fee-paying students (any nationality) with an offer for a 2027 taught master's at Lancaster who accept before 7 April 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for a taught master's at Lancaster
Accept your offer before 23:59 GMT on 7 April 2027
The £2,000 is applied automatically

lancaster-postgraduate-international-reg.about:
Lancaster University, a top-15 UK university, gives a £10,000 tuition fee reduction to international students from 12 underrepresented countries/regions — Canada, Egypt, Ghana, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey and Vietnam — starting a full-time, fully on-campus taught master's in 2027.

There is no form: you are considered automatically if you have (or are on track for) a 1st or 2:1 and accept an offer for 2027 entry. Students from other countries can receive Lancaster's Master's Excellence Scholarship instead.
highlights: Includes Egypt and Türkiye from the wider region
lancaster-postgraduate-international-reg.eligibility: Nationals or permanent residents of the 12 listed countries/regions with a 1st or 2:1 (or equivalent), accepting a 2027 offer for a full-time on-campus taught master's. Georgia and Qatar are not on the list.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible full-time taught master's at Lancaster
Accept your conditional or unconditional offer
The scholarship is applied automatically if you qualify

lancaster-undergraduate-international-ex.about:
Lancaster University, a top-15 UK university, rewards high-achieving international undergraduates starting in 2027 with a £3,000 tuition fee reduction for each year of study.

You qualify if you achieve A*AA at A level (or the equivalent in IB or another qualification), place Lancaster as your firm UCAS choice and pay international fees. Every nationality is eligible, including Georgia and Qatar. Eligible students are identified automatically; there is no form.
lancaster-undergraduate-international-ex.eligibility: International fee-paying applicants for 2027 entry who achieve A*AA at A level (or equivalent) and make Lancaster their firm UCAS choice.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Accept Lancaster as your firm choice.
Meet A*AA (or equivalent); the fee reduction is applied automatically.
lancaster-undergraduate-international-ex.costs: £3,000 tuition fee reduction per year of study.

lancaster-undergraduate-international-re.about:
The International Regional Scholarship is a £3,000 tuition fee reduction for each year of an undergraduate course starting in 2027, aimed at countries that are under-represented at Lancaster.

You must be a national of, or permanently live in, Canada, Egypt, Ghana, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Taiwan, Thailand, Türkiye or Vietnam, pay international fees and meet entry grades. Georgia and Qatar are not on the list (see the Excellence Scholarship instead).
highlights: 12 eligible countries incl. Türkiye and Egypt
lancaster-undergraduate-international-re.eligibility: International fee payers who are nationals or permanent residents of Canada, Egypt, Ghana, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Taiwan, Thailand, Türkiye or Vietnam, starting an undergraduate course in 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Meet the entry requirements of your offer.
The fee reduction is applied automatically.
lancaster-undergraduate-international-re.costs: £3,000 tuition fee reduction per year of study.

latvian-state-scholarships-2027.about:
The State Education Development Agency (VIAA) runs the Latvian state scholarship programme for foreign students, researchers and teaching staff from countries with which Latvia has an education agreement, including Georgia. Scholarships fund study periods (not full degrees) at Latvian higher education institutions and participation in summer schools.

Students must already be enrolled at a home university and arrange a host programme in Latvia. The scholarship includes a monthly stipend and, for many hosts, a tuition waiver. It is a good option for a funded exchange semester for students whose university lacks Erasmus+ links with Latvia.
highlights: Monthly stipend for study stays in Riga and other Latvian cities
Georgia listed among eligible agreement countries
latvian-state-scholarships-2027.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia and other countries with education agreements with Latvia (list published each year), enrolled in a degree programme at home, with a host institution in Latvia.
how_to_apply: Check viaa.gov.lv in January 2027 for the 2027/28 call.
Agree a study plan with a Latvian host institution.
Prepare the application form, CV, motivation letter, transcript, recommendation and host confirmation.
Submit to VIAA by the call deadline.
latvian-state-scholarships-2027.costs: Monthly scholarship set by Latvian Cabinet regulations (amount stated in the call); tuition is normally waived by the host institution.

lcc-international-university-aid-2027.about:
LCC International University is a small, English-speaking Christian liberal arts university in Klaipėda that recruits heavily from Eastern Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia. Tuition for 2027/2028 is €4,500 per year (60 ECTS), and dormitories start at €575 per semester.

Students can apply for both Need-Based Aid (10–80% of tuition, received by 9 out of 10 applicants) and scholarships such as the Kenneth and Helen Penner Scholarship (100% for four years for the top incoming student), Leadership & Innovation, Peacemaker and Faith in Action scholarships (70% in year one) and Values or Partner grants (20%). Combined grants can cover up to 90% of tuition.
highlights: Need-based aid for 90% of applicants (10–80% of tuition)
Full four-year scholarship for the top entrant
Low base tuition (€4,500/year) in the EU
lcc-international-university-aid-2027.eligibility: International applicants admitted to LCC bachelor's programmes; need-based aid depends on family finances and entry scores; individual scholarships have their own criteria.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to LCC for Fall 2027.
Submit the online Need-Based Aid application form as early as possible.
Apply for named scholarships (essays/recommendations as required).
Receive a combined aid package with your admission decision.
lcc-international-university-aid-2027.costs: Need-based aid 10–80% of €4,500 tuition; scholarships 20–100%; total typically capped at 90% of tuition when combining.

lcc-international-university-ba-financia.about:
LCC International University is an English-language liberal arts university in Klaipėda, Lithuania, popular with students from Eastern Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia. Bachelor's tuition for 2027/28 is €4,500 per year, and 63% of students receive financial aid.

Need-Based Aid (10%–80% of tuition) is based on family circumstances and admission scores; 9 out of 10 applicants receive it. You can also apply for 16 scholarships and grants (e.g. leadership awards), combinable up to 90% of tuition. Students from Georgia and other countries are eligible.
lcc-international-university-ba-financia.eligibility: BA applicants of any nationality; need-based aid by family finances and entry scores; scholarships by their own criteria.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to an LCC BA programme for 2027/28.
Submit the Need-Based Aid application form early.
Apply for any of the 16 scholarships/grants you qualify for.
You receive the highest-value combination up to 90% of tuition.
lcc-international-university-ba-financia.costs: Need-based aid 10–80% of tuition plus scholarships, total up to 90% of €4,500/year.

leeds-masters-international-excellence-s.about:
The University of Leeds offers a substantial number of Masters International Excellence Scholarships to reward high academic achievement. Awards are tuition fee discounts of £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 for the first year of an eligible full-time taught master's starting in September 2027 (the MBA and fully online courses are excluded).

You need an offer from Leeds, international fee status, self-funding (or partial funding) and at least a 2:1 or equivalent. The application form asks for your Leeds Student ID and Application ID, and you submit a separate form for each course offer. There are two rounds: 28 February and 16 May 2027.
leeds-masters-international-excellence-s.eligibility: International fee-paying, self- or partially-funded applicants with an offer for an eligible Leeds taught master's starting September 2027 and a 2:1 (or equivalent) bachelor's. All nationalities.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible taught master's at Leeds
Get your Student ID and Application ID after receiving an offer
Complete the scholarship form by 28 February 2027 (round one) or 16 May 2027 (round two)

leeds-undergraduate-international-excell.about:
Leeds (Russell Group) awards a substantial number of Undergraduate International Excellence Scholarships to self-funded international students starting a degree in September 2027. Awards of £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 are taken off first-year tuition.

Any nationality can apply, including Georgia and Qatar, as long as you are classed as international for fees and hold an offer. Selection is based on excellent school results, extracurricular achievements and a statement explaining why Leeds fits your ambitions. Medicine (MBChB) and Dentistry (BChD) are excluded.
leeds-undergraduate-international-excell.eligibility: Self-funded or partially funded international-fee students entering Year 1 of an eligible undergraduate course in Sept 2027, with an offer and strong grades and extracurriculars. Not Medicine or Dentistry.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS.
Wait for a conditional or unconditional offer.
Leeds emails offer holders a link to the scholarship form; submit one form per course.
Explain why you chose Leeds and how it fits your goals; submit by 11 April 2027.
leeds-undergraduate-international-excell.costs: One-off tuition discount of £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 in the first year.

leeds-undergraduate-international-region.about:
The Undergraduate International Regional Scholarship is an automatic £5,000 reduction on first-year tuition for international-fee students starting a Leeds undergraduate degree in September 2027, designed to ease the cost of moving to the UK.

It depends on your passport, not where you live: eligible passports are Canada, Egypt, all EU member states, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Nigeria, Norway, Singapore, Switzerland, Türkiye and the USA. Georgian and Qatari passports are not on the list. You must be self-funded or partially funded and entering Year 1.
highlights: Covers all EU passports plus 13 other countries
leeds-undergraduate-international-region.eligibility: Holders of an eligible passport (Canada, Egypt, EU, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Nigeria, Norway, Singapore, Switzerland, Türkiye, USA) paying international fees, self/partially funded, with an offer for Year 1 in Sept 2027. Not Georgia or Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply for your Leeds course via UCAS.
Hold a conditional or unconditional offer (Clearing offers count).
The £5,000 reduction is applied automatically to your first-year fee.
leeds-undergraduate-international-region.costs: £5,000 off the first year's tuition fee.

lincoln-global-undergraduate-scholarship.about:
The University of Lincoln offers Global Undergraduate Scholarships worth £2,000 per year as a tuition fee discount for full-time overseas-fee students joining an undergraduate programme in September 2027.

You must meet your programme's entry requirements and apply to Lincoln before Monday 16 August 2027. Any nationality qualifies (including Georgia and Qatar). The discount does not apply during placement or study-abroad years, and some advanced-entry students from China are excluded.
lincoln-global-undergraduate-scholarship.eligibility: Full-time overseas-fee undergraduates starting in September 2027 who meet entry requirements and apply before 16 August 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027). Lincoln's scholarship cut-off is 16 August 2027.
Meet the entry requirements of your offer.
The discount is applied automatically each year.
lincoln-global-undergraduate-scholarship.costs: £2,000 tuition fee discount per year of study.

lingnan-non-local-student-scholarships-2.about:
Lingnan University is Hong Kong's liberal arts university, with small classes and full residential life. Non-local applicants to its UGC-funded first-year programmes are automatically considered for three tiers of scholarship: Full Scholarship (tuition, hostel and partial academic and living expenses), Full-tuition Scholarship and Half-tuition Scholarship, each renewable for the normal study period with satisfactory results. Non-local tuition for 2027-28 is HK$205,000.

Programme-specific entrance scholarships (Economics, Business, Data Science, BScIDAI and others) are also open to non-local students. Apply online by the Main Round deadline (28 Feb 2027) for the best chance.
highlights: Full scholarship incl. hostel and living costs
lingnan-non-local-student-scholarships-2.eligibility: Non-local students admitted to UGC-funded first-year bachelor's programmes.
how_to_apply: Apply online to Lingnan with your international qualification by 28 Feb 2027
Submit transcripts, English test and personal statement
Scholarships are considered automatically with your admission
lingnan-non-local-student-scholarships-2.costs: Full scholarship: tuition (HK$205,000) + hostel + partial living; or full/half tuition.

lithuania-state-scholarship-masters-2027.about:
The Education Exchanges Support Foundation, on behalf of Lithuania's Ministry of Education, Science and Sport, offers state scholarships for full-time master's degrees (or the last two years of integrated studies) at Lithuanian higher education institutions such as Vilnius University, Kaunas University of Technology, Vytautas Magnus University and VILNIUS TECH.

The 2026 call offered 70 grants for citizens of Armenia, Azerbaijan, China, Georgia, Indonesia, Israel, Japan, Kazakhstan, Moldova, New Zealand, the Philippines, South Korea, Ukraine, the USA, Uzbekistan and Vietnam, plus foreigners of Lithuanian origin. Each grant includes a monthly scholarship of 8 Basic Social Amounts (€592 in 2026) and a grant covering the study cost up to the national standard. No more than 10 grants go to any one country, except Ukraine.

Applicants first secure admission to an eligible programme, then apply to the Foundation in spring.
highlights: Tuition plus a monthly stipend for the whole master's
Georgia is a named eligible country
English-taught programmes at Vilnius and Kaunas universities
lithuania-state-scholarship-masters-2027.eligibility: Citizens of the listed partner countries (Georgia included; Qatar is not listed) and foreigners of Lithuanian origin from non-EU/EFTA countries, applying for a full-time master's at a Lithuanian HEI.
how_to_apply: Pick an English-taught master's on studyin.lt and apply for admission
Watch studyin.lt for the 2027 Education Exchanges Support Foundation call (usually spring)
Submit the scholarship application with admission proof, CV, motivation and transcripts before the deadline
Results follow in early summer
lithuania-state-scholarship-masters-2027.costs: Monthly scholarship of 8 Basic Social Amounts (€592/month in 2026) plus a grant covering tuition up to the national standard study cost.

lithuanian-state-scholarships-masters-20.about:
Every year the Education Exchanges Support Foundation opens a call for Lithuanian state scholarships for full-time master's degrees (or the last two years of integrated studies) at Lithuanian higher education institutions.

The 2026 call was open to citizens of Armenia, Azerbaijan, China (incl. Taiwan), Georgia, Indonesia, Israel, Japan, Kazakhstan, Moldova, New Zealand, the Philippines, South Korea, Ukraine, the USA, Uzbekistan, Vietnam and foreign citizens of Lithuanian origin. Applicants need a bachelor's degree by the start of studies and an acceptance or pre-acceptance letter.

The award covers tuition up to the national standard study cost and pays 8 Basic Social Amounts per month (€592 in 2026), enough to live on in Vilnius or Kaunas.
highlights: Wide choice of English-taught master's programmes
lithuanian-state-scholarships-masters-20.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, China, Indonesia, Israel, Japan, Kazakhstan, Moldova, New Zealand, Philippines, South Korea, Ukraine, USA, Uzbekistan, Vietnam, or foreign citizens of Lithuanian origin, holding a bachelor's degree by the start of studies, with acceptance/pre-acceptance from a Lithuanian HEI.
how_to_apply: Apply to an English-taught master's programme at a Lithuanian university (most deadlines spring).
Obtain an acceptance or pre-acceptance letter.
When the 2027 call opens on studyin.lt, submit the scholarship application online with the letter, CV, transcript and motivation.
Wait for the Foundation's decision (usually summer).
lithuanian-state-scholarships-masters-20.costs: Tuition covered up to the national standard study cost; monthly scholarship of 8 BSA (€592 in 2026).

liu-international-scholarship-2027.about:
The LiU International Scholarship supports international master's students with significant academic potential who must pay tuition fees at Linköping University, known for engineering, computer science, medicine and interdisciplinary programmes. Holders normally have their tuition reduced by 50%.

To be eligible you must apply in the first admission round on universityadmissions.se (deadline 15 January 2027), submit all documents on time, rank a LiU programme first and be admitted in the first selection results (end of March). LiU also requires a GPA of at least 3.5/4.0 or equivalent. The scholarship application window opens in early April 2027 and is short; no extra documents are needed.
highlights: 50% tuition reduction for the whole master's
Can be combined with planning for SI scholarships
liu-international-scholarship-2027.eligibility: Fee-paying international students (non-EU/EEA, incl. Georgia and Qatar) admitted to a LiU master's as first priority in the first round, with GPA ≥ 3.5/4.0 or equivalent.
how_to_apply: Apply on universityadmissions.se by 15 January 2027 with a LiU master's as first choice
Pay the application fee and submit documents on time
After admission (end of March), apply for the scholarship in the early-April window

liverpool-excellence-scholarship-undergr.about:
The Liverpool Excellence Scholarship for Undergraduates is a £7,500 tuition fee discount for high-achieving international students starting a new undergraduate degree at the Liverpool campus (Russell Group). It is awarded automatically to every eligible student.

There is no nationality restriction: students from Georgia, Qatar or anywhere else who pay international fees and achieve AAA at A level or an equivalent qualification qualify. Clinical Medicine and Dental Surgery, online study and sponsored students are excluded, and it cannot be combined with other Liverpool scholarships. Liverpool is reviewing awards for 2027 entry, so check the page for final 2027 terms.
liverpool-excellence-scholarship-undergr.eligibility: New international-fee undergraduates at the Liverpool campus achieving AAA at A level or equivalent (country equivalents listed). Excludes Medicine, Dental Surgery, online study and sponsored students.
how_to_apply: Apply for your undergraduate course via UCAS.
Meet the AAA (or equivalent) grade requirement.
The discount is applied automatically to your fees.

ljmu-international-undergraduate-scholar.about:
LJMU's international scholarships range from £3,000 to £4,500 off tuition fees for undergraduate and postgraduate students. There is no separate application: if you meet the criteria, your scholarship status is shown in your unconditional offer letter.

You must hold an offer and have firmly accepted your place, not have already studied a degree at the same level at LJMU, and have funds for remaining costs. Courses with fees under £17,250 are excluded. Open to all international nationalities.
ljmu-international-undergraduate-scholar.eligibility: International fee-paying offer holders who have firmly accepted their place on an eligible LJMU undergraduate course (fees ≥ £17,250).
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Firmly accept your LJMU offer.
Your scholarship status is confirmed in your unconditional offer letter.

loughborough-international-excellence-sc.about:
Loughborough, a leading UK university for engineering, sport science and design, offers International Excellence Scholarships of £3,000 towards tuition fees for each year of study (up to £9,000 over a standard degree) for September 2027 entry.

All self-funded international fee-paying applicants of any nationality (Georgia and Qatar included) are considered automatically from their UCAS or OnCampus application. You must make Loughborough your firm choice and meet the academic conditions at the first sitting. The award does not apply in placement or study-abroad years.
loughborough-international-excellence-sc.eligibility: Self-funded international fee-paying applicants for Sept 2027 entry who firm Loughborough and meet the scholarship grade requirements at first sitting.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Make Loughborough your firm choice.
You are notified shortly after your offer if you have been awarded.
loughborough-international-excellence-sc.costs: £3,000 tuition reduction per year (not during placement/study-abroad years).

loughborough-postgraduate-excellence-sch.about:
Loughborough University rewards high-achieving master's students with the Postgraduate Excellence Scholarship: up to £6,000 off tuition for international students (£3,000 for UK students) on taught programmes starting in January or September 2027 at the Loughborough and London campuses. MBA and Sport, Exercise and Health Sciences programmes are excluded.

There is no form: you are considered automatically based on your application and final degree result.
loughborough-postgraduate-excellence-sch.eligibility: International and UK applicants (any nationality) to eligible Loughborough PGT programmes starting January or September 2027 with high grades.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible taught master's
Receive your offer; eligibility is assessed automatically
Award confirmed on final degree result
loughborough-postgraduate-excellence-sch.costs: Up to £6,000 tuition fee reduction for the first year. Living costs not covered.

luther-college-international-scholarship.about:
Luther College is a liberal arts college in Decorah, Iowa, that strives to meet the financial need of admitted international students, though aid is limited and many families contribute half or more of costs. International students are automatically considered for Academic Merit Scholarships (up to US$39,000 a year) and Global Leaders awards (need and campus contribution), and all receive a health insurance grant (~US$1,800), a US$800 transition grant and a guaranteed on-campus job (~US$3,800).

Talent scholarships add more: Music (up to US$7,000/yr), Theatre (up to US$3,000/yr), Math (up to US$5,000/yr), Sustainability (up to US$1,250/yr, apply by 1 Feb) and Davis UWC (up to US$25,000/yr for UWC graduates).
highlights: Merit up to US$39,000 a year, automatic
Extra music, theatre, math and UWC awards
luther-college-international-scholarship.eligibility: International first-year applicants to Luther College.
how_to_apply: Apply to Luther via Common App or Luther's application
Merit and Global Leaders awards are automatic
Apply for talent scholarships by their deadlines (Sustainability 1 Feb 2027)
luther-college-international-scholarship.costs: Merit up to US$39,000/yr plus grants against total cost of about US$65,000.

maastricht-nl-high-potential-scholarship.about:
The Maastricht University NL-High Potential Scholarship combines UM's own Scholarship Fund with the Dutch government's NL Scholarship to give 18 full awards per year to highly talented non-EU/EEA students admitted to a participating UM master's.

For 2027-28 the package covers tuition, visa costs, pre-academic training and health/liability insurance, plus a living allowance of €20,150 for a one-year master's (13 months) or €38,750 for a two-year master's (25 months). Flights are not covered. You need a GPA of at least 7.5/10 (75% or 3.0/4.0).

Apply to the master's through Studielink with a complete file by 10 December 2026, then submit the scholarship form (CV, motivation letter, transcript, financial-need statement, reference letter) between 1 October 2026 and 1 February 2027. Only one submission is allowed.
highlights: Visa, insurance and pre-academic training paid
maastricht-nl-high-potential-scholarship.eligibility: Nationals of countries outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and Suriname (incl. Georgia and Qatar) admitted to a participating UM master's, with GPA ≥ 7.5/10 or equivalent.
how_to_apply: Apply to a participating master's via Studielink and complete your file by 10 December 2026
Log in to the UM portal with your student ID
Upload CV (2 pages), motivation letter on UM template, transcript, financial-need statement and reference letter
Submit the scholarship form once, by 1 February 2027
maastricht-nl-high-potential-scholarship.costs: Tuition, visa, insurance (€700) and pre-academic training paid; living allowance €20,150 (13 months) or €38,750 (25 months). Flights not covered.

maastricht-um-nl-global-studies-scholars.about:
The UM NL Global Studies Scholarship offers full coverage (tuition fee waiver plus monthly stipend; €20,150 for living expenses in 2027-28) for the three-year, English-taught Global Studies bachelor's at Maastricht University, a problem-based programme with an interdisciplinary thesis. Places are very limited (one full scholarship per academic year for selected top students).

You must hold the nationality of a country eligible for OECD Official Development Assistance (this includes Georgia; Qatar is not ODA-eligible), have no EU/EEA/Swiss/Surinamese dual nationality, demonstrate financial need and strong development potential, be 35 or younger on 1 Sept 2027, and have submitted a complete Global Studies application before 10 December 2026.
maastricht-um-nl-global-studies-scholars.eligibility: Nationals of OECD ODA-eligible countries (Georgia included; not Qatar), no EU/EEA/Swiss/Surinamese dual nationality, with financial need, admitted (conditionally) to Global Studies for 2027-28, application file complete before 10 Dec 2026, aged ≤35.
how_to_apply: Apply to the Global Studies bachelor's via Studielink and UM, with a complete file before 10 December 2026.
Receive your UM student ID.
Submit the scholarship application (motivation, proof of need, documents) between 1 Oct 2026 and 1 Feb 2027.
Shortlisted candidates go through UM's selection procedure.
maastricht-um-nl-global-studies-scholars.costs: Tuition fee waiver plus €20,150 per year for living expenses (2027-28 figure), for 36 months.

macalester-turck-presidential-honor-scho.about:
Macalester College in Saint Paul, Minnesota, is known for its strong international focus: about one in seven students comes from outside the US. Each year it awards the Charles J. Turck Presidential Honor Scholarship, worth up to US$40,000 a year, to a limited number of international students with strong academic potential. All international applicants are considered automatically.

Macalester also offers need-based aid to international students. Admission is need-aware and competition for aid is keen. Aid packages include on-campus work (about 9 hours a week) and may include institutional loans.

Apply Early Decision I / Early Action by 9 Nov, Early Decision II by 8 Jan or Regular Decision by 22 Jan 2027. Aid applicants must submit the CSS Profile or the free International Student Application for Financial Assistance (ISAFA) and the Macalester Financial Declaration Form, or they will not be considered for admission.
highlights: Merit award up to US$40,000 a year, automatic consideration
Free ISAFA form accepted instead of the CSS Profile
macalester-turck-presidential-honor-scho.eligibility: Non-US citizens applying as first-year students. Aid must be requested at admission; students cannot apply for aid after enrolling.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by 22 Jan 2027 (RD) or earlier rounds
For aid: submit the CSS Profile or 2027-28 ISAFA
Submit the Macalester Financial Declaration Form from the applicant portal
Merit scholarship is decided automatically from your application
macalester-turck-presidential-honor-scho.costs: Turck scholarship up to US$40,000 a year toward tuition (~US$70,000+); need-based grants, campus work and loans can cover more.

manchester-met-undergraduate-internation.about:
Manchester Metropolitan University's Undergraduate International Scholarship takes £2,000 off tuition for each year of an eligible taught bachelor's degree on the Manchester campus, for self-funded students paying full overseas fees and starting in September 2027.

There is no separate application; eligibility is assessed when you apply. It cannot be combined with other Manchester Met financial support. Open to all non-UK nationalities.
manchester-met-undergraduate-internation.eligibility: Self-funded overseas-fee students accepted onto a full-time taught bachelor's at the Manchester campus starting September 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Accept your offer.
The scholarship is applied automatically each year.
manchester-met-undergraduate-internation.costs: £2,000 tuition fee reduction per year of study.

master-mind-scholarships-flanders-2027.about:
Master Mind Scholarships are awarded by the Flemish Ministry of Education and Training to outstanding students from around the world who enrol in a master's programme at a higher education institution in Flanders or Brussels. Recent rules gave a grant (listed as €10,225 per year by Study in Flanders, or a one-off €5,375 allowance per UAntwerp's current page) plus a tuition fee waiver for the duration of the study.

You cannot apply directly to the ministry: the host university selects and submits candidates, so contact the international office early. At the University of Antwerp, all applications must be filed through the university by 1 February. The scheme is under review for 2027-28, so check the latest rules before applying.
highlights: Tuition waived plus a cash grant
Top Flemish universities incl. KU Leuven and Ghent
master-mind-scholarships-flanders-2027.eligibility: Outstanding international students (all nationalities, incl. Georgia and Qatar) applying for an eligible master's at a Flemish higher education institution; university-specific nationality or programme rules may apply.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible master's at a Flemish university
Contact the university's international office about Master Mind
Submit the Master Mind dossier through the university by its deadline (UAntwerp: 1 February)
University nominates candidates to the ministry
master-mind-scholarships-flanders-2027.costs: Tuition fee waiver plus a grant (amount under review for 2027-28).

mcmaster-award-of-excellence-internation.about:
McMaster University in Hamilton, Ontario, is a top-200 research university known for health sciences, engineering and its DeGroote School of Business. Its Award of Excellence is worth up to CA$200,000 over four years for international fee-paying students with strong academics, community engagement and personal growth, entering Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences.

Apply through AwardSpring (opens 1 Nov 2026, closes 19 Feb 2027). McMaster also gives automatic international awards: DeGroote Business CA$15,000-25,000 in year one (renewable), Humanities and Social Sciences Scholars CA$10,000 (renewable at CA$5,000), Science Global Scholars CA$10,000 then CA$7,500/year, and Engineering/Computer Science international entrance awards of CA$10,000.
highlights: Up to CA$200,000 over four years
Automatic faculty awards of CA$10,000-25,000 too
mcmaster-award-of-excellence-internation.eligibility: International fee-paying students entering full-time first year in Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences, staying in their admitted faculty.
how_to_apply: Apply to McMaster through OUAC
Create an AwardSpring profile and complete the Award of Excellence application (from 1 Nov 2026)
Submit by 19 Feb 2027
Automatic faculty awards are assessed from your admission average
mcmaster-award-of-excellence-internation.costs: Up to CA$50,000 a year toward international tuition (~CA$50,000-70,000).

mext-japanese-studies-georgia-2027.about:
The Japanese Studies track of the MEXT scholarship lets undergraduates who major in Japanese language and culture outside Japan spend up to one year at a Japanese university improving their language and studying Japanese affairs. It is not a degree programme: students return to finish their degree at home.

In Georgia the Embassy of Japan runs the first screening (documents, a written test and a face-to-face interview in February) and recommends successful candidates to MEXT, which announces placements in July–August for arrival in September–October.
highlights: Year in Japan fully funded by MEXT
For Georgian students of Japanese language/culture
First screening in Tbilisi in February
mext-japanese-studies-georgia-2027.eligibility: Georgian citizens enrolled in an undergraduate programme at a university outside Japan, majoring in a field related to Japanese language and culture, within the MEXT age range (for 2025: born 2 April 1995 – 1 April 2007).
how_to_apply: Watch the Embassy's site in January for the call.
Complete the MEXT Japanese Studies application form and placement preference form (fillable PDFs) and the health certificate.
Submit by e-mail to culture@tb.mofa.go.jp and in person/by post to the Embassy before the deadline.
Take the written exam and interview in February; await MEXT's decision in summer.
mext-japanese-studies-georgia-2027.costs: Tuition waived; monthly MEXT allowance; round-trip airfare.

mext-undergraduate-embassy-georgia-2028.about:
Every year the Embassy of Japan in Georgia recommends Georgian candidates to Japan's Ministry of Education (MEXT) for the Japanese Government Scholarship. The embassy round covers Undergraduate Students, College of Technology (KOSEN) Students, Specialized Training College Students and Research Students (research students are listed separately on Meridian).

For the 2027 programme, applicants had to submit originals to the Embassy and a digital copy to culture@tb.mofa.go.jp by 5 June 2026; written exams followed in late June and interviews in early July, before final selection by MEXT. Guidelines and exam subjects are published on Study in Japan.

MEXT is one of the most generous undergraduate scholarships in the world: it includes a preparatory year of Japanese and covers the whole degree.
highlights: Full tuition, ~JPY 117,000 monthly stipend and return airfare
Includes a preparatory year of Japanese language
Georgia-only embassy round with exams in Tbilisi
mext-undergraduate-embassy-georgia-2028.eligibility: Georgian citizens meeting MEXT age limits (for undergraduates typically aged 17–24 at the start of the programme) who have completed or will complete 12 years of schooling; willingness to learn Japanese; good health. See each category's guideline on Study in Japan.
how_to_apply: Read the 2028 guideline for your category on studyinjapan.go.jp when the Embassy publishes the call (spring 2027).
Prepare the application form, placement preference form, transcripts, graduation certificate, recommendation and health certificate.
Submit originals to the Embassy of Japan (Chavchavadze Ave. 64b, Tbilisi) and the digital set to culture@tb.mofa.go.jp by the deadline.
Sit the written exams (late June) and interview (early July).
Wait for MEXT's final decision and university placement.
mext-undergraduate-embassy-georgia-2028.costs: MEXT pays tuition, entrance and exam fees, a monthly allowance (around JPY 117,000 for undergraduates under current rules) and round-trip airfare.
